companies.sub: 抄紙機用ファブリック

relations.text: 抄紙機用ファブリックのHeimbachを買収(2023年8月)
relations.text_en: Acquired paper machine clothing maker Heimbach (August 2023)

source.label: Albany International 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On August 31, 2023, the Company acquired all the outstanding shares of Heimbach, a privately held manufacturer of paper machine clothing with headquarters in Düren, Germany.

relations.text: 航空部品の最大顧客(売上の約15%)。LEAPエンジンのファンブレード・ケース
relations.text_en: Largest aerospace customer (about 15% of revenue): fan blades and cases for the LEAP engine

source.label: Albany International 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: AEC's largest aerospace customer is SAFRAN and sales to SAFRAN (consisting primarily of fan blades and cases for CFM's LEAP engine) accounted for approximately 15% of the Company's consolidated net revenues in 2025.

relations.text: ボーイングの民間機の大半に真空式汚物タンクを供給
relations.text_en: Supplies vacuum waste tanks for most Boeing commercial aircraft

source.label: Albany International 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: AEC also supplies vacuum waste tanks for most Boeing commercial aircraft, as well as the fan case for the GE9X engine used on the Boeing 777 aircraft.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
